checks.basis: Character and weapon rarity tables are separated and each exact probability table sums to one under exact decimal arithmetic.
Hard pity forces UR at 100 and featured guarantee forces a featured UR at 200; featured and UR counters reset according to the sealed outcome contract.
Compatible carryover families preserve pity progress while incompatible destinations do not silently consume source-family progress.
Paid, reset-free, ad-free and other-free ruby ledgers are distinct; paid ruby is consumed last and refunds do not silently debit free ledgers.
Refund processing rejects alreadySpent greater than the affected grant and represents spent paid-value shortfall as an explicit audited deficit rather than negative unsigned balance mutation.
First copy is functional, marginal mastery gains diminish, full mastery is long-term and overflow converts to a retained currency.

findings.finding: The contract defines p50/p90/p99 and long-horizon economy targets, but Step 2 has not executed the full high-volume distributions needed to accept those targets as balanced.
findings.requiredNextStage: Run the sealed Step 3 gameplay and Monte Carlo volumes and reject/tune any candidate that misses the acceptance ranges without reusing the holdout for tuning.
